datum: Heights are metres above a sphere of radius 1737.4 km (the LOLA reference), Mean Earth / Polar Axis frame, east-positive longitude.
fileFormat: LXG: gzip-compressed header + int16 grid with a lossless predictor; see src/terrain/lxg.ts. Rebuild with: npm run build-dem
notBundled: North polar layers: the north pole is covered by the whole-Moon grid only (1.9 km).

North of the 80S square nothing finer than the whole-Moon grid is bundled, apart from the windows around the catalogued landing sites (public/terrain/). The elevation server builds 60 m windows for other coordinates on request (needs network access).

layers.name: LOLA south pole, 87.5S square at 40 m
layers.footprintNote: Square of 151.6 km centred on the south pole (polar stereographic). Complete south of 87.51S; towards its corners (longitudes 45, 135, -135 and -45) it reaches 86.5S.

provenance.product: LRO LOLA LDEM_875S_20M (PDS product version V2.0, created 2017-06-15)
provenance.processing: Each 40 m sample is the mean of 2x2 samples of the 20 m source grid, rounded to 0.5 m (the source stores 0.5 m steps; largest rounding change 0.25 m). Same projection and extent as the source.
provenance.citation: Smith, D. E., et al. (2017). Summary of the results from the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter after seven years in lunar orbit. Icarus, 283, 70-91. Data: LRO LOLA Gridded Data Records (LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0), NASA Planetary Data System, Geosciences Node.

layers.notCovered: Nothing north of the square. Detail finer than 40 m; the source's own 20 m grid is not bundled.

layers.name: LOLA whole-Moon grid, 16 px/deg

provenance.product: LRO LOLA LDEM_16 (PDS product version V3.1, created 2019-03-15)
provenance.processing: Columns rearranged to run from 180W to 180E (the source runs 0E to 360E); heights rounded from the source's 0.5 m steps to 1 m (largest change 0.5 m). No resampling.
provenance.citation: Smith, D. E., et al. (2017). Summary of the results from the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter after seven years in lunar orbit. Icarus, 283, 70-91. Data: LRO LOLA Gridded Data Records (LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0), NASA Planetary Data System, Geosciences Node.

layers.notCovered: Relief narrower than about 1.9 km (each sample stands for a 1.9 km cell at the equator): sharp ridges and small craters are smoothed.

layers.name: LOLA whole-Moon overview, 4 px/deg

provenance.product: LRO LOLA LDEM_4 (PDS product version V3.0, created 2017-09-15)
provenance.processing: Columns rearranged to run from 180W to 180E (the source runs 0E to 360E); heights kept at the source's 0.5 m steps. No resampling.
provenance.citation: Smith, D. E., et al. (2017). Summary of the results from the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter after seven years in lunar orbit. Icarus, 283, 70-91. Data: LRO LOLA Gridded Data Records (LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0), NASA Planetary Data System, Geosciences Node.

layers.notCovered: Anything smaller than about 7.6 km. Meant for drawing the globe quickly, not for analysis.
